text:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: routing the streaming/chat reliability actions into the remediation sprint. Focus areas we decided: deterministic partial short-circuit, SDK reconnect backoff + circuit-breaker, session pinning for long-lived streams, telemetry/alert windows, repro harness, and customer comms. Assign owners and solid dates so we can schedule work.

elliot: I'll own SDK reconnect + circuit-breaker. Plan: introduce a lightweight client-side circuit-breaker that opens on 5 consecutive partials/timeouts for the same session to avoid reconnect storms. RFC by 2026-03-24, PR by 2026-03-31, canary 2026-04-09. Default: open for 30s, exponential retry after.

priya: Observability + alerts: add metric stream.partial_rate (per-route/model), session.circuit_open_count, and streaming.handshake_latency p50/p95/p99. Proposed alert: stream.partial_rate >0.35% sustained 5m OR session.circuit_open_count >0 (page). Target: 2026-03-22. Will add a dashboard tile that shades customers with >0.5% partials.

hao: I'll build the repro harness and session pinning proof-of-concept. Deliverables: 1) harness that injects truncated chunks and delayed frames, 2) session pinning toggle in runtime to keep long-lived sessions on same worker for 60s, 3) nightly CI job to run the harness. Target: 2026-03-20.

maya: Server rule clarification: deterministic partial short-circuit should mark event=partial_shortcircuit and trigger fallback to sync generation path (graceful degrade) for user-visible sessions. Persist the full request KV snapshot to logs for 45s and link in traces. Also require product-facing note before any public-facing canary.

elliot: Example SDK config I plan to propose (for feedback):
```json
{ "streaming": { "reconnect": { "enabled": true, "strategy": "exp", "initial_ms": 120, "max_ms": 2000, "max_attempts": 6 }, "circuit_breaker": { "enabled": true, "fail_threshold": 5, "open_ms": 30000 } } }
```
This includes a conservative circuit to avoid bursty reconnects.

ops-bot: Tickets created: RW-STREAM-1301 (elliot), RW-STREAM-1302 (priya), RW-STREAM-1303 (hao).

priya: I'll add the alert runbook: on fire, page oncall, attach top 10 request IDs, flip smoke test to run streaming daily with injected partials, and tag customers impacted in the internal comms ribbon.

hao: For session pinning POC, I'll add config: pin_ms=60000 and a fallback to reassign on worker overload. Will attach memory/CPU profiles to the ticket.

elliot: Noted runtime concern: pinned sessions might reduce packing efficiency. I'll add an opt-in flag and runtime guard to only pin when sequence length > X or when client sets session.pin=true. Will coordinate with eng-runtime before PR.

smoke-bot: Scheduled smoke run: nightly 03:00 UTC with flaky network profile. Failure threshold for alert: 3 failing tests in a 24h window.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged + canary stable 72h with partial_rate decreased vs baseline, circuit open events are rare, telemetry kept 14d, retro then close actions. Product to vet customer comms before canary. 10m sync Thursday to check blockers.

priya: ACK  will link dashboard and runbook to RW-STREAM-1302 before canary.

elliot: ACK  linking RFC + PR to RW-STREAM-1301 shortly.

hao: ACK  attaching POC to RW-STREAM-1303.

maya: Thanks all — we'll validate metrics in the nightly smoke run and confirm next steps on Thursday.
